title: Trading-Card Portfolio Movers
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tradingcard:price
| streamstats current=f last(price) as prev by card
| eval change_pct=round(100*(price-prev)/prev,1)
| stats latest(change_pct) as move, latest(price) as price by card
| where abs(move)>10
| sort - move
description: Flags the trading cards in your collection whose price moved sharply, so you catch a spike worth selling into.
value: Card prices swing on reprints and hype; a movers view lets you act on a spike instead of learning about it too late.
implementation: Ingest card price feeds into `index=personal`; alert on large price moves in cards you own.
visualization: Table of biggest price movers among owned cards.
grandmaExplanation: It flags trading cards whose value jumped or dropped a lot, so you can sell at a good time.
